title: Tahiti Coastal Circle Road

waypoints.name: Papeete
waypoints.advice: Papeete is where the day begins. Next is Pointe Venus, 21 km on.

waypoints.name: Pointe Venus
waypoints.advice: Pointe Venus comes up 21 km in. Next is Tiarei waterfalls, 21 km on.

waypoints.name: Tiarei waterfalls
waypoints.advice: 42 km in you reach Tiarei waterfalls. Next is Teahupoo, 21 km on.

waypoints.name: Teahupoo
waypoints.advice: Teahupoo, about halfway. Next is Taravao, 21 km on.

waypoints.name: Taravao
waypoints.advice: Taravao sits at 84 km, late in the day. Next is Papeete, 21 km on.

waypoints.name: Papeete
waypoints.advice: The route ends here after 105 km.

sections.advice: Papeete → Pointe Venus is 12 km of rhythm rather than effort. Let it flow and let the view breathe.
Pointe Venus → Tiarei waterfalls is 20 km of rhythm rather than effort. Let it flow and let the view breathe.
Tiarei waterfalls → Teahupoo is 44 km of rhythm rather than effort. Let it flow and let the view breathe.
Teahupoo → Taravao is 15 km of rhythm rather than effort. Let it flow and let the view breathe.
Taravao → Papeete is 41 km of rhythm rather than effort. Let it flow and let the view breathe.

provenance: CURATED FROM THE ARCHIVE: waypoints taken from the named road Tahiti Coastal Circle Road. Distances between stops are great-circle with a road factor, not a routed measurement - the pipeline replaces them when it routes this line.

scenicChapters.title: Tahiti Coastal Circle Road
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 9 km this is Tahiti Coastal Circle Road, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.
